howItWorks.title: One rail. Every critical condition.
howItWorks.subtitle: Six steps from counterparty verification to settlement.

steps.title: VERIFY
steps.desc: Buyer and exporter KYB — identity, ownership, sanctions, trade history.

steps.title: CONTRACT
steps.desc: Digital transaction terms — commodity, quantity, quality, Incoterms, release conditions.

steps.title: COMPLY
steps.desc: Build the compliance pack — export docs, SFDA, phytosanitary, lab COA.

steps.title: INSPECT
steps.desc: Independent inspection and laboratory evidence against contract specifications.

steps.title: SECURE
steps.desc: Funds coordinated through licensed financial partners — escrow, not custody.

steps.title: RELEASE
steps.desc: Settlement occurs when predefined transaction conditions are satisfied.
